priority_recommendation.name: one fixed TRAIN101_479 specialist PhysicsField, three known loads
priority_recommendation.question: Can the same load-linear native field fit both displacement values and mesh-recovered P1 gradients on an already diagnosed single training geometry once the multi-CAD conditional sharing/optimization competition is removed?
priority_recommendation.why_this_first: It keeps the geometry, target definitions, load basis, calibrated coefficient and existing native architecture in the current DeepJEB problem. The zero-gradient/lambda1 value-versus-gradient tradeoff has already been measured; moving to exact2 or another generic target setup would add data/model/target changes before resolving this narrower question.
priority_recommendation.not_a_method: Extra per-CAD specialist model is a representability/optimization diagnostic, not a deployable new generalization model or evidence of novel architecture.

one_run_contract.minimal_budget_interpretation: Only one extra model/run and one fixed CAD, not three independent per-load models or a multi-CAD suite. 250-step exposure-matched diagnostic readout and the capped10k representability endpoint belong to the same run.

exposure_and_capacity_caveats.250step_scope: Matches expected per-load case-slot exposure of shared10k, not exact stochastic sample realization, gradient trajectory, other-case diversity, walltime or optimizer state. It is a bounded early readout, not a second run or a formal matched capacity control.
exposure_and_capacity_caveats.parameter_count: Per specialist model architecture/capacity is unchanged versus shared xyz3. Keeping a separate specialist in addition to the shared model increases total deployed parameters and dedicates all optimization to one CAD.
exposure_and_capacity_caveats.representation_claim_limit: Any10k improvement conflates reduced multi-CAD interference, effective per-CAD parameter allocation and about40x case exposure. It cannot prove insufficient shared model width or missing condition encoding alone.

decision_readout.both_u_and_P1_fit_much_better: Shows the existing local native field/loss can jointly fit this fixed geometry under dedicated optimization; multi-CAD conditional sharing or optimization competition is a plausible contributor, without proving which mechanism or any unseen-CAD transfer.
decision_readout.u_fits_P1_does_not: Leaves spatial-gradient fit/mesh recovery/precision/optimization or fixed coefficient tradeoff as live limitations on this CAD; output rounding oracle alone was previously insufficient to explain941% error, but native arithmetic is not rigorously excluded.
decision_readout.P1_fits_u_does_not: Shows the derivative-value compromise persists even without multi-CAD sharing; this alone does not establish a constitutive law or need for more global geometry capacity.
decision_readout.neither_fits: No representability proof: finite budget, optimizer and weighting remain alternatives. Do not automatically increase capacity, sweep lambda/seeds or claim impossibility.
decision_readout.no_followup_suite: This note offers no second seed, hyperparameter sweep, new encoder, exact2 generic objective experiment, stress branch, new finaltest or dia access. Parent decides any later action from the fixed readout.
